correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md and exact-rational check_ultrametric_haar.py. The metric embedding with tree lengths (r_{t−1}−r_t)/2 gives Kantorovich–Rubinstein mass-flow norm; norm duality reduces signed transforms to images of leaf-pair molecules. After first split, the two row branches are independent, and the scalar Bellman recurrence W_s yields F_s for each level with one greedy sign choice optimizing all descendant mass levels. Abel summation gives positive-tail formula; geometric sum and limiting radius criterion follow. Partial Haar projections and cylinder density are justified on little-Lipschitz only. Independently enumerated exact rational Bellman values for depths one through six. Neither finite tests nor saved log substitute for transport/density proofs.

value.rationale: Determines the exact sensitivity of a canonical multiscale Haar basis to sign flips in a natural ultrametric Lipschitz norm, for arbitrary distance scales, and pinpoints unconditionality by a meaningful uniform decay condition. This is stronger than an existence-of-basis statement and identifies sharp geometric-radius dependence.

final_claim: For real uniformly normalized binary Haar transforms on finite first-divergence ultrametric leaves, sharp sign norm equals the weighted F_s sum over levels/max divergence; geometric radii have the stated closed form and infinite-depth limit. On the little-Lipschitz Cantor quotient the Haar basis is unconditional precisely under bounded normalized tail radii, equivalently uniform block contraction, with exact sign constant.
